blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Justine Sanchez stepped up in the College of St. Benilde’s 94-82 win over Arellano in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at Philsports Arena on Friday. The veteran guard led the Blazers with 17 points, eight rebounds and five assists as they improved to a league-best 6-1 record in Group A.
